purpose: C1 installation extrinsics worksheet for the front camera / IPM line following.
frame_convention: vehicle frame: x forward, y left, origin base_link

camera.measurement_point: record whether height was measured to the CMOS plane or the lens front

procedure: Measure height_m, x_m, y_m with a tape; record the measurement point.
Place the 5 ground markers at the coordinates above.
Fill an initial pitch/roll from measurement + visual estimate, project the markers to BEV.
1-D search pitch (0.1 deg step) to minimise BEV X error.
Adjust roll until the +/-0.5 m markers are symmetric in BEV Y.
Accept when 5-point BEV RMS < 1.5 cm and the pitch residual curve is flat within +/-0.5 deg.
Write data/calib/front_camera_extrinsics.yaml with calibrated: true + date + method.
